title: Pregnant Blend 4-Mix Trio #15 (가로 띠·물결 / 동심원·물결 / 대각 띠·물결)
prompt:

Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 44% of the way down her figure from the top, about 59% of the way down her figure from the top and about 77% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with morphing tessellation filling the space between bands. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with acanthus scrollwork filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.
